description: Move or reassign a single-service booking to a new date, time, staff member, resource or schedule slot. Multi-service appointments must be handled in the merchant dashboard. Runs conflict, capacity and rebooking-policy checks, enforces actor permissions and outlet access, syncs the booking calendar, and returns the updated booking.

endTime.description: New end time in HH:MM format

resourceId.description: Assign this resource ID; null clears the assignment

scheduleId.description: Target schedule slot ID when moving between schedule windows

staffId.description: Reassign to the staff userId returned by list_staff; null clears the assignment

startTime.description: New start time in HH:MM format
